method.candidate_stage: Let U be the unique-number union of the five actual purchased lines and M the count of the six winning main numbers inside U. Evaluate M/6 and the fixed-U uniform-draw null X~Hypergeometric(N=45,K=U,n=6).
method.allocator_stage: Conditional on the observed M and the exact five-line membership geometry, enumerate every C(U,M) equally likely winning subset. For each subset, calculate five line hit counts, max_hit, any2+, any3+, any4+, total winning-number appearances, and duplicate winning appearances.
method.interpretation_limit: The conditional allocator null is a diagnostic conditioned on the observed portfolio union and M. It is not the primary H1250 strict null, does not test predictive edge, and does not turn two exposed historical rounds into an untouched holdout.

results.diagnostic: Observed max_hit=2 and gap=1 are ordinary under the exact conditional allocation distribution; the larger loss is that only 3 of 6 winners were present in a 16-number portfolio union.
Observed max_hit=3 and gap=2 are common under the exact conditional allocation distribution. Five of six winners were retained in the 18-number union, but the portfolio still had no 4+ line.

combined_two_round_summary.interpretation: The two actual portfolios had small unique unions (16 and 18 across 30 ticket slots). Conditional allocation outcomes were not unusual given the retained-winner counts. This is a two-round diagnostic, not evidence to select or reject an allocator.
